title: Belligerent Woman Threatens Employee Then Endangers Her Kid's Life
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On April 30th, 2023. Officers received a call from an employee regarding two highly belligerent females who were threatening staff and raining down insults. Before the officer had arrived, the two females left the store and sped off with a high rate of speed with a child in the car. When the officers conducted the traffic stop on them, they were less than compliant, she continued to be belligerent and extremely rude to the point where officers deemed it was right to place her under arrest. The other female that accompanied her also refused to obey lawful commands, officers told her to step away while her friend was being arrested however she refused to listen, she kept recording and calling people to the scene, as she though the officers were in the wrong until the officers had enough and placed her under arrest aswell. All this happened while they had a child in the car.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
